title: सहिष्णुतावादी नेपाली समाज र यसका चुनौतीहरू Sahishnutavadi Nepali Samaj ra Yaska Chunautiharu
nepali: विश्वका प्राचीन देशहरूमध्येको देश नेपाल र नेपालीसमाजको निर्माणको इतिहास हजारौ“ वर्षको रहेको छ । मूलतः नेपाली समाजको निर्माणमा खस–आर्य तथामङ्गोल समुदायका मानिसहरूको विशेष भूमिका छ । ईसापूर्व सयौ“ वर्ष अगाडि नै नेपाली समाजका अनेकौ“जातजातिका मानिसहरूका पुर्खा मूलतः नेपालकाछिमेकी मुलुकहरू चीन र भारततर्फबाट नेपाल प्रवेशगरेका हुन् । बसाइ“–सराइ तथा छिमेकी मुलुकहरूमाभएका राजनीतिक–सामाजिक सङ्घर्ष आदिको परिणामपनि विभिन्न जातिका मानिसहरू नेपाल प्रवेशगरेका छन् जसका कारण नेपाल विविध जातजातिकामानिसहरूको सङ्गमस्थल बनेको छ । त्यसैले विविध जातजातिका मानिसहरू आ–आºना धर्म–संस्कृति निर्वाधरूपमा मान्दै एकआपसमा मिलजुल गरी हजारौ“ वर्षदेखियहा“ बसिरहेका छन् । यहा“ कुनै जातीय–धार्मिक सङ्घर्ष भएको इतिहास छैन र यहा“को समाज सहिष्णुतावादी समाजका रूपमा विद्यमान छ । यो सहिष्णुतालाई कायम राखिरहने वातावरणको निर्माणमा निरन्तरता दिइरहनु नै यसको चुनौती हो ।
american_english: Among the ancient countries of the world, Nepal is one, and the history of the formation of Nepali society spans thousands of years. Fundamentally, the Khas-Arya and Mongol communities have played a special role in building Nepali society. Hundreds of years before the Common Era, the ancestors of the many castes and ethnic groups of Nepali society entered Nepal mainly from the neighboring countries of China and India. As a result of migration and of the political and social conflicts in neighboring countries, people of various castes and ethnicities have also entered Nepal, because of which Nepal has become a meeting point of diverse peoples. Therefore, people of diverse castes and ethnicities have been living here for thousands of years, freely practicing their own religion and culture and living together in harmony with one another. There is no history of any ethnic or religious conflict here, and the society here exists as a tolerant society. The challenge is to keep sustaining the environment that preserves this tolerance.
british_english: Nepal is one of the ancient countries of the world, and the history of the making of Nepali society stretches back thousands of years. At root, the Khas-Arya and Mongol communities have had a special part to play in the making of Nepali society. Hundreds of years BC, the forebears of the many castes and ethnic groups of Nepali society entered Nepal chiefly from the neighbouring countries of China and India. Migration, together with the political and social conflicts in neighbouring countries, has also brought people of various castes and ethnicities into Nepal, which is why Nepal has become a confluence of diverse peoples. Thus people of diverse castes and ethnicities have been living here for thousands of years, freely observing their own religion and culture and mixing harmoniously with one another. There is no history of any ethnic or religious conflict here, and the society here is a tolerant one. The challenge is to keep up the continuity of creating an environment that sustains this tolerance.
australian_english: Nepal is one of the world's ancient nations, and the history of how Nepali society came together runs back thousands of years. In essence, the Khas-Arya and Mongol communities have played a key role in shaping Nepali society. Hundreds of years before the Common Era, the ancestors of Nepali society's many castes and ethnic groups came into Nepal mainly from the neighbouring countries of China and India. Migration and the political and social struggles in neighbouring countries have also led people of various castes and ethnicities to enter Nepal, and as a result Nepal has become a gathering place of diverse peoples. So people of diverse castes and ethnicities have been living here for thousands of years, freely keeping up their own religion and culture and getting along together in harmony. There is no history of any ethnic or religious conflict here, and the society here exists as a tolerant society. The challenge is to keep going with building an environment that keeps this tolerance alive.
informal_english: Nepal's one of the oldest countries around, and Nepali society's been taking shape for thousands of years. The Khas-Arya and Mongol communities played a big part in building it. Way back before the Common Era, the ancestors of all our different castes and ethnic groups came into Nepal mainly from China and India next door. Migration and the political and social scraps in those neighbouring countries brought in people of all sorts of castes and ethnicities too, which is why Nepal's become a meeting point of so many different peoples. So all these different folks have been living here for thousands of years, freely keeping their own religion and culture and getting along with each other. There's never been an ethnic or religious clash here, and our society's a tolerant one. The real challenge is keeping that tolerance alive by sustaining the environment that holds it together.
